Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low relative neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, with a slightly elevated basophil percentage. Hemoglobin and other red cell indices are within normal limits. Biochemistry and liver function tests are unremarkable. INR is mildly elevated. Findings may suggest mild bone marrow suppression or peripheral destruction; clinical correlation and follow-up are recommended.
